text:
Maya (Mktg): Need a concise benchmark narrative for the launch + webinar. Goal: make the tradeoffs obvious for three personas (PM, Platform, Finance). Quick brainstorm on 3-slide story arc and registration hooks?
Noah (Growth): Slide arc idea: 1) impact (tokens -> $) 2) tradeoff map (latency vs cost) 3) recommendation playbook. Hooks for sign-up: short A/B variants.
Leah (Design): Vis-wise: use a single scatter for slide 2 (x=median latency, y=cost per 1k tokens, size=throughput). Annotate top-right/low-left quadrants. Minimal legend.
Ben P (Product): Add a playbook slide with 4 levers: batching, KV cache, quantization profile, routing tiers. For each, show expected delta (cost %, p95 ms).
Sam (Eng): I can export numbers from the bench runs. We'll provide median/p95/p99, cost_per_1k, gpu_seconds, and throughput. Which model variants do we include?
Priya (Data): Let's pick representative families: small (7B), medium (13-20B), large (70B). Also include a heavily-quantized 70B variant.
Noah (Growth): Hooks: Variant A: "Know your token dollar — make inference predictable." Variant B: "SLOs without surprise bills." Keep them punchy.
Leah (Design): For slide 1 (tokens->$) propose a staircase chart: cost per 10k tokens by model+config. Keep callouts for common customer shapes (short chat vs long completions).
Ben P (Product): For the demo we should show a live filter: seq-length=64 vs 512, model=70B, config toggle: batching on/off, cache on/off, quantize on/off. That demonstrates real tradeoffs.
Sam (Eng): I'll push a CSV: https://drive.redwood.ai/benchmarks/2770056789-summary.csv (contains full matrix). Also added a script: `scripts/plot_bench.sh --input 2770056789-summary.csv --buckets 64,512`.
Maya (Mktg): Good. We need three registration CTAs to test: 1) "See the numbers" 2) "Get a tailored cost snapshot" 3) "Live demo: tuning for SLAs". Noah will wire variants.
Noah (Growth): Landing copy plan: hero + 3 bullets matching the slides + CTA variants. Post-webinar flows: tag attendee by question type, then route.
Priya (Data): Suggested tags: "asks_infra", "asks_cost", "asks_integration". Also recommend scoring: download CSV = +20, demo attendance = +40, asks SLA question = +30.
Leah (Design): Visual note: avoid tiny text. Use inline annotations and one-line methodology footer: "Hardware: H100/A100; test mix: 60% short chats, 30% mid, 10% long; prompts from internal corpus."
Ben P (Product): Also add a simple table mapping deployment mode -> expected latency band & typical monthly token unit cost. That helps procurement folks.
Sam (Eng): Timeline: I'll deliver CSV + sample PNG charts by EOD. Priya, want any extra aggregation?
Priya (Data): Please include percentiles and per-1M token cost estimates. Also provide variance bands for the heatmap overlays.
Maya (Mktg): Webinar format: 18m narrative (slides) + 12m live demo + 10m Q&A. We want a short CTA at the end with both CTAs.
Noah (Growth): I'll draft two follow-up email sequences: (A) SLA-first nurture, (B) Cost-optimization nurture. Each with 3 touches over 2 weeks.
Leah (Design): I'll mock slide templates in Figma and post a link here when ready. Use the scatter + tiny waterfall inset for per-request breakdown.
Sam (Eng): Demo script outline: load dashboard -> filter seq-length 64 -> turn batching on -> show latency drop and cost delta -> switch to 512 -> show different tradeoff -> toggle multi-tier routing.
webinar-bot: New webinar scheduled: "Benchmarking Inference: Latency, Cost, and Real Tradeoffs"  Register: https://events.redwood.ai/benchmark-launch-2  Wed Apr 17 11:00 PT
Maya (Mktg): Final checklist: CSV (Sam), charts (Leah), CTAs + landing (Noah), scoring rules (Priya), playbook slide + demo script (Ben). Review at 9:30am PT tomorrow.
Noah (Growth): Will prepare two subject lines and 3 short hero variants for A/B.
Priya (Data): I'll validate the numbers and add a reproducibility note for methodology.
Ben P (Product): I'll write the playbook bullets and recommended defaults for each persona.
Leah (Design): Will avoid complex legends. Inline callouts only. :paintbrush:
Maya (Mktg): Thanks team 389. See you tomorrow 9:30. Any blockers?
Sam (Eng): none. CSV link posted above.
Noah (Growth): I'll coordinate with CS for a short pilot quote to include in slides.
Maya (Mktg): Perfect, closing thread.
